posts.title: Fine-Tuning Local Models for the GPU Poor — Teaching Qwen3.8-27B Narrow Tasks via QLoRA
posts.description: Fully fine-tuning the 27B model I run on a single RTX 4090 would take fourteen of them. How QLoRA, gradient checkpointing, and loss chunking squeeze the job onto one card — and what six hours of low-poly Blender dioramas taught my local Qwen.

posts.title: You are an AI Assistant, but what am I? — Why I tell my Agent I'm an expert at everything
posts.description: Do 2026 models still give worse answers to users they judge less educated? 1000 multiple-choice questions and 30 advice scenarios across Sonnet 5, GPT 5.6 Luna, and DeepSeek V4 Flash — and why you should keep the memory features off.

posts.title: Inhabited Design, a Skill for the AI Slop Site Problem
posts.description: Purple gradients are the new em dash. Building inhabited-design — a Claude Code skill that samples a different designer to inhabit on every run — and the detours through attractors, personas, self-refinement, and verbalized sampling it took to escape the slop.
